newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa surges ahead of the close as funds buy.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa surges ahead of the close as funds buy.

text.p: CSCE cocoa prices shot up some five percent in late trading Monday, bolstered by heavy fund buying, traders said.

Benchmark September jumped to a new life-of-contract high of $1,700 a tonne, but by 1400 EDT, stood at $1,695, up $82. Spot July was up $97 at a contract high of $1,663, the highest nearby level on the continuous weekly charts since 1989.
The back months -- which also set lifetime highs -- rose $37 to $80.
Traders said the buying was mainly chart-driven, helped by supportive CFTC data, a weaker dollar and a bullish long-term fundamental outlook.
Volume as of 1300 was heavy at an estimated 10,916 lots.
